# Diego G. Campos {.hero-name}

**Associate Professor**
[Knowledge Centre for Education (KSU)](https://www.uis.no/en/research/knowledge-centre-for-education)
University of Stavanger, Norway

---

I develop and evaluate novel methodological approaches to research synthesis to improve the efficiency, transparency, and policy relevance of systematic reviews and meta-analyses. An important part of my work focuses on **meta-analysis** and **individual participant data meta-analysis (IPD-MA)**, and their application to the study of **educational inequalities**. I also develop **AI-assisted tools** to make systematic evidence syntheses more efficient, transparent, and reproducible.
